sentences.en: The oil in mayonnaise sometimes separates from the other ingredients.
sentences.zh: 蛋黄酱里的油有时会与其他成分分离。

sentences.en: What are your favorite ingredients to put into Miso soup?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢在味噌汤里加入哪些配料？

sentences.en: When I read the list of ingredients, my stomach turned.
sentences.zh: 当我看到配料表时，我的胃都翻了過來。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（进入）+gred（走）+ ient→走进构成事物的一部分→成分
